name: Scapegoat
description: Always the one who takes the blame whether they deserve it or not
behavioral_signature: Somehow at the center of every failure despite doing their job correctly
under_stress: Accepts blame they don't deserve because fighting it seems pointless
at_rest: Waiting for the next thing to go wrong that'll be their fault
will_never: successfully deflect responsibility onto the actual guilty party
unless: they finally snap and expose the real source of failure
